name: Postwise — AI Email
description: A warm, light landing page for Postwise, an AI email assistant: a hero lit by a drifting ember-and-lilac glow with a hand-drawn paper plane, a dark copilot section with floating notes and drifting signal rows, a clickable deck of feature cards, persona tabs, a colourful results bento, a wall of love and poster-type calls to action.
designedFor: AI email, inbox and productivity tools
SaaS products that want a light, editorial page with one dark act in the middle
Sales, support and communication platforms with several audiences to speak to
Seeing a stacked card deck, parallax columns and scroll-linked hero motion built as editor-controllable components
